user.title: PCX86-kiosk
user.description: The integration is added automatically after a Debian panel publishes its retained MQTT discovery message.

confirm.title: Panel discovered: {name}
confirm.description: Choose how this panel appears in Home Assistant and optionally assign it to an area.

abort.no_devices_found: No panel was discovered. Check that the Debian agent is running and connected to the same MQTT broker, then restart Home Assistant or retry discovery.
abort.invalid_discovery: The MQTT announcement is invalid or does not match the PCX86-kiosk topic contract.

init.title: Optional media player
init.description: Select the Music Assistant Sendspin player for this panel. This setting can be changed after discovery.
